{{Current events|year=2023|month=03|day=2|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–23 Western Russia attacks]]
***[[2023 Bryansk Oblast attack]]
****[[Russia]] accuses a Ukrainian [[sabotage]] group of attacking the villages of Lyubechane and Sushany in [[Bryansk Oblast]] and taking [[hostage]]s. However, [[Ukraine]] accuses Russia of staging a false "provocation". [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-forces-are-fighting-ukrainian-sabotage-group-border-region-russian-news-2023-03-02/ (Reuters)]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***A [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] missile strike on an [[apartment]] building in the city of [[Zaporizhzhia]] kills three [[civilian]]s and injures at least four others, according to [[Ukrainian police]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-strike-kills-3-zaporizhzhia-says-ukraine-police-2023-03-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Six people are killed and five others are injured by a [[methane]] [[explosion]] in [[Harnai District]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan| Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-coal-mine-methane-explosion-workers-killed-5b9f46b1e84a57287aae17c9a0ee18a0 (AP)]
*Twenty people are injured by severe [[turbulence]] on a [[Condor (airline)|Condor]] flight from [[Frankfurt]], [[Germany]], to [[Mauritius]]. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-mauritius-flight-turbulence-injured-cade054ad390a79ef0761117c40e6421 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Brazil–Israel relations]]
**[[Israel]] criticizes the [[government of Brazil]] for allowing two [[Iran]]ian [[warship]]s to dock in [[Rio de Janeiro]] and urges [[Brazil]] to send the warships away calling it a "dangerous and regretful development". [https://www.reuters.com/world/israel-urges-brazil-undock-iranian-warships-2023-03-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Vietnamese presidential election]]
**The [[National Assembly (Vietnam)|National Assembly]] of [[Vietnam]] elects [[Võ Văn Thưởng]] as the country's new [[President of Vietnam|president]], succeeding [[Nguyễn Xuân Phúc]]. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Politics/Vietnam-s-parliament-elects-Thuong-as-new-president (Nikkei Asia)]
